subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Rivian R1T
description: Learn The Rivian R1T in one minute.

hook.text: Rivian did what no startup had done—built a truly compelling electric truck from scratch.

buildup.text: The R1T combined off-road capability, a camp kitchen, and 300+ miles of electric range.

discovery.text: It was the first electric pickup to reach customers in 2021, beating Tesla, Ford, and GM to market.

twist.text: Rivian burned billions in cash getting to production. Amazon's delivery van order kept them alive.

climax.text: The R1T proved the adventure vehicle market could go electric without sacrificing ruggedness.

punchline.text: Rivian built the truck for people who leave the pavement.
